mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS id,category_code AS code,category_name AS name,status FROM cat_category WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND category_code=#{code}

SELECT unit_id AS id,unit_code AS code,unit_name AS name,status FROM cat_unit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND unit_code=#{code}
